sections.name: Priced as services. Size moves your number more than the label does.

items.text: Services
Priced as services. Size moves your number more than the label does.

Services businesses are bought on earnings, and the multiple rises with size. One survey puts services within a turn of information technology at the same size. A transaction database puts them more than ten turns apart. We do not know which is right, and we will not pick one silently.

items.text: Two readings of the same question
How far below software is a services business priced? The published answers disagree.
Both readings are shown. Your own number depends on size, on contracts and on what the earnings are once they are traced to source.
Information technology, same $1M to $5M band, same survey
Against 6.2 times for business services. Less than a turn apart.
Services deals under $5M, from a transaction database
Against 17.2 times for software deals of the same size. More than ten turns apart.
Average multiple at $10M to $25M of enterprise value
Rising to 6.6, 8.7 and 10.0 times in the three bands above it, up to $250M.
Median multiple at $5M to $50M of enterprise value, Q2 2026
From 255 advisers reporting 181 closed deals.

Pepperdine Graziadio Business School, 2026 Private Capital Markets Report, July 2, 2026. An M&A advisory firm’s analysis of a transaction database, July to August 2026. GF Data, January 27, 2026, nine months of 2025. IBBA and M&A Source, Market Pulse, Q2 2026. The survey and the database measure different things and are not reconciled here.

items.text: What the review covers
A one-time engagement on your own business, using the same evidence standard a buyer will apply.
This is non-attest preparation. It shows you what a buyer’s quality of earnings is likely to find, while there is still time to act on it.
Earnings, traced
Revenue reconciled to bank deposits, and reported earnings tied to the records behind them.
Every adjustment, marked
Each add-back you or your adviser proposes is marked supported or unsupported, with the document that decides it.
Customers and payers
Concentration, retention and contract terms, read the way a buyer will read them.
Contracts and licenses
Assignability, change-of-control terms, and the compliance items a buyer’s counsel will ask about.
A findings report and workbook
What was found, what it affects, and what to fix first. Yours to keep. See the full review.
Come prepared.

Capital Row is the M&A firm that reads your numbers the way a buyer will, before you go to market. Every figure traced to a source document, every adjustment marked supported or unsupported, and the findings are yours to keep.
